claim: Accepts CSV, TSV, and plain-text study files.
sandbox: Open /demo; choose one CSV, one TSV, and one text file; each produces an exportable inspected row.

claim: Recognizes comma, tab, semicolon, pipe, and Prompt :: Answer input.
sandbox: Open /demo; inspect five one-card sources using each advertised shape.

claim: Finds incomplete cards and omits them from exports.
sandbox: Open /demo; observe the incomplete finding and inspect the downloaded pack.

claim: Finds duplicate cards and omits later duplicates from exports.
sandbox: Open /demo; observe the duplicate finding and verify unique exported prompt-answer pairs.

where: How it works and format documentation
sandbox: Open /demo; download the pack and verify the formula-like prompt begins with an apostrophe.

claim: Removes non-HTTPS media links from exports.
where: How it works and format documentation
sandbox: Open /demo; download the pack and verify unsafe media is blank while HTTPS media remains.

claim: Uses each mapped field once and exports the selected source column.
sandbox: Open /demo; move Prompt to another column, retain keyboard focus, and inspect the downloaded value.

claim: Exports a version-1 portable practice-pack JSON file.
where: Export panel, README, and format page
sandbox: Open /demo; download the practice pack and verify its filename, format, version, fields, and cards.
Open /demo; download CSV and verify the header, cleaned row count, formula prefix, and removed unsafe link.

claim: Checks and exports study material locally without upload.
where: Landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: Record every request during the /demo export flow and assert all requests remain on the current origin.

claim: Does not retain your real study material after reload.
sandbox: Leave /demo, inspect a private card, reload, and assert the input and browser storage contain no private content.

claim: Has no accounts, cookies, analytics, or third-party requests.
sandbox: Open a fresh real session; assert cookies are empty and every load request uses the current origin.

claim: Checks material after the page has loaded, even when the connection drops.
where: Landing facts and inspector connection notice
sandbox: Open /demo in a new browser context, set it offline, then inspect a valid card without a request.

claim: Is free under the MIT License.
where: Landing facts, terms page, and README
sandbox: Open /terms and verify the visible free-use and MIT License terms.

claim: Documents a portable JSON format with no proprietary identifiers or continuing service requirement.
sandbox: Open /format and verify the visible portability and no-account statements.

claim: Accepts files through 5 MiB and rejects larger files with guidance.
where: Inspector helper text and file error
sandbox: Choose an exact 5 MiB CSV and then a 5 MiB plus one byte CSV; verify accepted inspection then focused rejection guidance.

claim: Provides a resettable sample that never changes your real material.
sandbox: Open /demo, alter the sample, reset it, start for real, and verify the real input is empty and demo marker is removed.
